recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5755 unless the work group opens a new editorial issue to restructure Questionnaire or QuestionnaireResponse examples.
issue_request: FHIR-5755 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care ballot comment for FHIR-core-QuestionnaireAnswers asking that the examples or element scope be general and allowable for multiple purposes, not limited to medications and immunizations.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in SVN #4174, migrated as git commit da69de4c27ee463d8f8b538d46833c7f48daff79, which changed questionnaireanswers-introduction.xml to broaden the example list. The artifact was later renamed from QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse in c51b8682420300c0f51dd0ad260d0be7f5ae20ab.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is the current active build artifact. Current QuestionnaireResponse examples cover general, lifelines, BlueBook, Glasgow Coma Score, and family-history response scenarios, and current Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse narrative explicitly says these resources can capture any type of data. FHIR-3015 is related background on Questionnaire/QuestionnaireAnswers subject breadth, but did not require a separate decision in this seed reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source already conveys the requested broad-use clarification through examples and narrative, so additional prose would be redundant rather than corrective.
